_comment: Storm-creature arc emission (tools/art_pipeline/arc_emission.py). Owner 25 Oct: glow only where natural to the element -- lightning arcs on storm creatures, never seams on fur or hide. Each entry builds an emissiveTexture from the albedo's painted arcs only. Owner-picked remakes (1 Nov 2026, flag-off candidates): the glowing eyes and the concept's glowing lines, veins or paws get the same albedo-derived emissive map.

tanglevolt._why: Coordinator 25 Oct (order 4): Tanglevolt's lightning veins are painted into the albedo with no emissive map, so since the 24 Oct Forward+ emission-floor change they light like fur on Medium and High. Stormursa ships a real emissive map and is unaffected.

terrapup_owner1101._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov (concept: jade eyes). Eyes only: the mossy stone plates sit at hue 60-100 and stay unlit.

bramblebun_owner1101._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov (concept: bark plates with glowing green veins, green eyes). The thin bright veins and eyes only; the broad leaf tail (yellower, no lift over its surroundings) stays unlit.

trailpup_owner1101._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov (concept: nearly real coyote, glowing amber paws and eyes). Paw pads and eyes; a wide blur so the broad pads still lift above the tan coat.

brooktail_owner1101._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov (concept: deep-river otter with glowing aqua spots; owner 25 Oct: bioluminescence is natural on water creatures).

pipwing_owner1101._why: Owner-picked remake 1 Nov (concept: glowing ice-blue eyes and wing-feather edge lines). Eyes only: the feather edges sit at the same saturation as the pale-blue coat (median 0.34, 99th pct 0.44), so any mask that takes them lights the whole wing; left unlit rather than glow the coat (owner 25 Oct: no glowing seams on fur or hide).
